title: Merchandise a ShieldCare Plan May Be Sold On
content:
Each Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan is sold only on merchandise of the departments it
names, and only where the item's recorded purchase price falls inside the plan's price band.
The band is stated as an inclusive minimum and an inclusive maximum in USD.

| Plan | Departments the plan may be sold on | Price band, USD, inclusive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | small appliances and audio | 49.99 to 999.99 |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | laptops, tablets, handsets and cameras | 199.99 to 2499.99 |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | laptops, tablets, handsets, consoles and cameras | 299.99 to 4999.99 |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | televisions, projectors and home theatre audio | 999.99 to 24999.99 |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | major appliances | 399.99 to 9999.99 |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | business IT fleet equipment | 149.99 to 49999.99 |

### Both sides of a band

An item recorded at exactly 49.99 falls inside the band of ShieldCare Essential Parts and
Labour, because the minimum is inclusive; an item recorded at 49.98 falls outside it. An item
recorded at exactly 999.99 falls inside that same band at its top, and also inside the band of
ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium at its foot, so the department the item belongs to is what
separates the two. An item recorded at 1000.00 is above the band of ShieldCare Essential Parts
and Labour altogether.

### Where the bands overlap

The bands are not exclusive of one another. A laptop recorded at 350.00 sits inside the bands
of both ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus and ShieldCare Total Device Protection and inside
the departments both name. A television recorded at 1500.00 sits inside the band of
ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium and inside no other plan's departments.
